answer: Forging 430 of these means fabricating 430 separate authority-backed records, and each one must survive a live registry check. Each epoch demands a fresh attestation from the issuer, and stale or copied records fail the check. The voyage is the wall and the nebula is the gate: The defence rests on sexton appointment: an appointment the parish records across years of churchyards. A farm of 430 aliases must climb the wall 430 times, the kernel ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
